# IA Lorient - Paul Giunta

## About
IA Lorient is a freelance automation and AI service based in Lorient, Brittany, France. Paul Giunta helps very small and small businesses (TPE/PME) remove their repetitive tasks (quotes, follow-ups, reporting, re-typing between tools) without changing their existing tools. The site is a single page: who Paul is, then his work for real clients, the method, questions and contact.

## Work for real clients (each one runs every day at a client, adapted to each new client, owned, no subscription)
1. E-commerce: a store engine that builds a complete Shopify store from a few documents (pages, collections, mobile version); each product gets its written page, studio and on-model photos per colour, and translated images.
2. Coaching: each new sign-up becomes a personalized program, laid out and sent automatically on WhatsApp, then a weekly review; programs written by AI in the coach's method and checked before sending.
3. Sales agency: commercial tracking and per-salesperson dashboards that update themselves, plus action buttons inside GoHighLevel (change a status, log an action, trigger a follow-up in one click).
4. Websites: a clean, fast website in the client's name, hosted on the client's own account, with a simple guide for everyday changes.
5. Consulting: a HubSpot CRM that tells you each morning who to follow up with and why, with automatic email tracking and a clear pipeline.
6. Prospecting: finding target companies, finding and checking contacts, preparing outreach.
Also built to measure: custom CRM, automated business documents, auto-updating dashboards, connections between tools, AI for lead qualification and content, smart alerts.

## Pricing
Everything is on quote: a fixed price agreed before work starts. The first exchange is free and without commitment. No subscription: what Paul builds belongs to the client and runs on the client's accounts.

Lorient, Bretagne, France. Serving Lorient, Lanester, Hennebont, Quimperlé, Ploemeur and the wider Pays de Lorient.

## Background
Paul Giunta is a former engineer at Naval Group (3 years), then team manager at Philips and partner support at Booking.com, turned automation specialist. He builds end-to-end automation systems with n8n, Notion, Google Sheets, Python and AI tools.
